subject: MSA: Inspection playbook — evidence ownership & QA asks
messages:
From: Megan Ruiz <megan.ruiz@clearwelltx.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.example.com, laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Cc: procurement@clearwelltx.com
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: MSA redlines — security exhibit / inspection questions

Hi Irene and Laura,

Thanks for taking the MSA redlines. We attached the redlined MSA and a short list of questions specifically about the security exhibit and inspection language. Two quick items that bubbled up from our InfoSec team:

1) Pen-test window — they want clarity on whether testing requires a 30-day notice and whether staging access will be provisioned (or if we need to coordinate a snapshot/forensic export).
2) Evidence cadence — we're used to receiving a weekly evidence bundle for 2 weeks during onboarding (SOC2 artifacts, architecture diagrams, attestation pdfs, log-samples). Can Redwood accommodate a lightweight weekly sync + a one-time handoff of artifact packages?

We copied procurement to signal this will be attached to the order form for final sign-off. Attached: Clearwell_MSA_redlines_20280628.pdf.

Can you confirm who on the Redwood side will own evidence delivery and the contact for scheduling a pen-test window?

Thanks,
Megan
Megan Ruiz
Head of Security Operations
Clearwell Therapeutics
attachments: Clearwell_MSA_redlines_20280628.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>
To: Megan Ruiz <megan.ruiz@clearwelltx.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: 2028-07-01T13:36:00Z
Subject: Re: MSA redlines — security exhibit / inspection questions

Hi Megan — thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the redlines. 

We can support the flow you described; below is a practical, operational playbook we propose for onboarding and the inspection/pen-test steps. Please review and flag anything we should adjust.

Proposed assurance playbook (high level):
- Evidence handoff: Redwood will provide an initial evidence bundle (SOC 2 Type II report summary, architecture diagram, key policy extracts, and a small sample of redacted logs) within 5 business days of order form acceptance.
- Weekly syncs: Two weekly 30-min evidence syncs during onboarding (weeks 1 and 2) to walk through artifacts and answer clarifying QA questions.
- Pen-test coordination: We require a formal pen-test request (date range + scope) with a minimum 14-calendar-day notice for internal scheduling. For external vendor testing we ask for a short vetting form (vendor name, test type, IPs) and agree to either:
  a) grant ephemeral staging access during the agreed window, or
  b) provide a staged snapshot and redacted logs for offsite testing if staging access is not possible.
- Evidence owners: I suggest Redwood owners be: Laura Bennett (assurance lead) for SOC2/attestations, Vanessa Ortiz for evidence packaging and staging access, and Karthik Iyer for legal coordination with your contracts/procurement team.

Action items for Clearwell:
1) Confirm whether you prefer ephemeral staging access or snapshot exports for vendor pen-tests.
2) Share preferred windows for onboarding-week 1 and 2 syncs (Megan — cc procurement for calendar options).
3) If a vendor will run pen-tests, send vendor name and IP ranges for the vetting form.

I've attached a short assurance-runbook draft and an evidence-matrix template to show how we'll map artifacts to your SOC2 assertions. If that looks good, Laura will follow up with a compact evidence delivery plan and a single DocuSign orderform link.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
attachments: assurance-runbook-v1.pdf, evidence-matrix.xlsx

From: Megan Ruiz <megan.ruiz@clearwelltx.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwelltx.com, security@clearwelltx.com
Date: 2028-07-02T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: MSA redlines — security exhibit / inspection questions

Irene — this looks good and much more actionable than our initial ask. A few clarifying points from our InfoSec team: 

- Staging access preference: We prefer option (a) ephemeral staging access when feasible. Snapshot exports are acceptable for higher-risk data segments but add extra steps.
- Pen-test notice: 14 days is workable. Please confirm the window length we should expect Redwood to reserve (e.g., 1–3 business days of reserved bandwidth/engineer support during the window).
- Evidence deliverables: Our compliance reviewers would like a redacted example of an access log (one-day sample) as part of the initial evidence bundle. Is that something you can provide with PII removed?

Procurement note: we'll sign the orderform once the final MSA redlines are incorporated along with a short assurance appendix that spells out the weekly syncs and pen-test coordination. We saw a DocuSign link in your last note — please send when ready.

Thanks,
Megan

On a related note, forwarding your playbook internally for quick review: 
> From: Megan Ruiz
> Subject: MSA security exhibit
> Internal comment: Legal will want a single paragraph limiting the inspection to scope in the exhibit; Procurement requests a clause for cost recovery if additional evidence transforms into a recurring deliverable.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
To: Megan Ruiz <megan.ruiz@clearwelltx.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.example.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: 2028-07-03T15:07:00Z
Subject: Re: MSA redlines — security exhibit / inspection questions

Thanks Megan — glad that plan lands. Quick summary from our side and owners so we can close each line item: 

1) Evidence bundle (owner: Laura Bennett) — deliverables: SOC2 summary, architecture diagram, redacted access-log sample (1 day), policy excerpts, and an evidence index. Delivery ETA: within 5 business days of signed orderform.
2) Scheduling & staging access (owner: Vanessa Ortiz) — Redwood will reserve up to 2 business days of on-call support during the agreed pen-test window (we recommend booking a 48-hour window). Vanessa will coordinate ephemeral staging credentials and the vendor vetting form.
3) Legal / contract redlines (owner: Karthik Iyer) — Karthik will propose a single inspection-limitation paragraph and a short cost-recovery carveout for recurring, out-of-scope evidence requests. He will circulate a tracked-change redline of the security exhibit by EOD Friday.

Next steps: 
- Karthik: will send the redline proposal and confirm the language on cost recovery.
- Vanessa: will send the vendor vetting form + a DocuSign orderform link (docusign-orderform-CLW-0583-link.txt).
- Laura/Irene: will package and deliver the initial evidence bundle after the signed orderform.

Megan — could you confirm today whether Clearwell prefers the 48-hour reserved window (recommended) or a shorter 24-hour window? Once we have that, Vanessa will propose two candidate dates for the pen-test.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Assurance Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: docusign-orderform-CLW-0583-link.txt
